findings.title: Spoofable x-vercel-isr header re-enables query-param path override on every function
findings.why_it_matters: The ISR branch trusts a plain request header with no secret, and the same entrypoint bundle backs _render, _isr, and non-ISR builds. If a client can deliver x-vercel-isr: 1 to the function (the repo never sets or verifies this header, and Vercel's stripping of client-sent x-vercel-* headers cannot be confirmed here), then GET /api/public?x_astro_path=/api/private with that header on _render or a non-ISR deploy rewrites the path to a different route again. That is the unauthenticated override that #15959 closed, and it bypasses any path-keyed access control in front of the function. Restricting the branch to the ISR function build removes the exposure on _render and non-ISR deploys even if the header turns out to be spoofable on _isr.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an `isr` boolean to the virtual:astro-vercel:config module (createConfigPlugin in src/index.ts), and have the ISR entry build (buildISRFolder for '_isr') set it; only evaluate the x-vercel-isr/x_astro_path branch when that flag is true, so _render and non-ISR builds never honor the query param. Also confirm with Vercel that x-vercel-isr is injected platform-side and stripped from client requests; if not, pair it with a trusted signal (e.g. a secret bypassToken-style check) instead. Assumption: x-vercel-isr is set by the platform on prerender-function invocations.
evidence: packages/integrations/vercel/src/index.ts:451-474 -- ISR builds still call buildServerlessFolder(entryFile, NODE_PATH, ...) and buildISRFolder(entryFile, '_isr', ...) with the same entryFile, so _render carries the same branch; the non-ISR path also uses it
x-vercel-isr is referenced nowhere else in the repo (grep), so nothing ties it to the ISR function or authenticates it
packages/integrations/vercel/test/path-override-security.test.js -- the existing spoof tests send neither x-vercel-isr, so the new branch is unexercised

residual_risks: Assumes Vercel sets x-vercel-isr on ISR prerender-function invocations and strips or overwrites it on client requests; not verifiable offline, and the fix has only been checked manually against a test project.
Direct client requests to /_isr?x_astro_path=... or /_render are reachable via Vercel's filesystem handler; whether x-vercel-isr can be client-supplied there is the crux of the P0 concern.
testing_gaps: No test covers the new ISR branch: neither that x-vercel-isr: 1 plus x_astro_path rewrites on the _isr function, nor that x_astro_path stays ignored on _render and non-ISR builds when x-vercel-isr: 1 is sent. Adding the positive and negative cases next to test/path-override-security.test.js would catch a future regression of either #15959 or this fix.
